artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Read-only dossier census for all continuation-partition names (95). Copies the gateway _pick_dossier rule from the cl3/ci3 census, builds dossier.build in memory, compares fields by parsed value, derives cause from the differing input entries, applies the refresh's allowed-set skip rule and the CTO model-block guard. The S3 wrapper forwards get, head, list and the list paginator on opal-data-harvest only; budget 14000 requests and 1.8 GiB. No write function is referenced; the file has no gold or silver writer and no build call to Bloomberg or a model.

Census output of one slice run per 10-to-20-name foreground command (six slices) and one --final run; LF endings; the CENSUS-DOSSIER-MOVE-98 line is last. Controls: CONTROL-POSITIVE 0, CONTROL-NEGATIVE 1 on UNH_US_Equity.
Slice parts file of the census: SLICE lines (gets and bytes per slice) and per-name COST lines; the --final run reads it and refuses on any missing or duplicate name.

Read-only inventory: schedule registers and the dell1 schtasks export (CSV, scratch), a read-only scan of the shared checkout (lib, integrations, infra, .tools) for dossier writers with per-extension denominators, the build-cost reduction of the COST lines, and list_objects_v2 on the newest derived/model_block stamps of ten names. No put, copy or delete.
Inventory output, one foreground run (exit 0); the INVENTORY line is last. Ten landings are printed with their UTC stamps and the spread.
Four rows appended by bytes in a5ee5d551c (86 insertions, 0 deletions): AMGT_HARVST-D1-W178-S1 to S4. The row gate passed on the staged file without any override.
